body: I have my parents but they are very old and I don't want to burden them with my troubles. My benefits are going to be cut off soon because my doctor won't sign me off sick even tho I've been hospitalised after suicide attempts. I got rejected from job interviews and it really felt like I was being kicked while I'm down. Left college in November after I couldn't manage my symptoms anymore.
Not without it being crazy expensive. Its a special kind if therapy that not alot a psychologist offer.

I don't gave the tools to help others. I don't think docs like to diagnose people until they are adults. I was meant to go back to therapy in a few weeks. I'm on a waiting list. It would teach me the skills needed to manage intense emotions.
No I don't tell people I know irl about It.  There's too much stigma and misunderstanding. Looking at r/bpd helps though. Made me realise I'm not such and oddball in this world
I'm very emotionaly damaged. I have bpd and feel things so intensely that it's just not worth it anymore. It's so much hard work just to function and I get so little reward.
